result.summary: The intersection lacks basic pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and pedestrian signals, despite being controlled by traffic lights for vehicles. The wide, unmarked roadway and poor pavement quality create a high-exposure environment for pedestrians with no designated crossing zones.

result.summary: The intersection is equipped with sidewalks and traffic signals, including pedestrian signal heads, but lacks marked crosswalks. The environment is a mix of institutional and residential uses with significant on-street parking that may impact visibility at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Unmarked Crosswalks
hazards.description: Despite the presence of pedestrian signals, there are no painted markings on the roadway to define the pedestrian path or alert drivers to the crossing location.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner can block the sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Markings
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to clearly define the pedestrian right-of-way and increase driver awareness.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to improve sightlines for both pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Construct curb extensions to reduce the crossing distance and further improve visibility by placing pedestrians further into the street before they cross.

result.summary: The image shows an urban intersection with mixed-use buildings that lacks fundamental pedestrian safety infrastructure such as marked crosswalks and curb ramps. The roadway surface is significantly degraded, and the absence of pedestrian signals at a signalized intersection increases risk for those crossing.
